annotations.title: List, add or remove quick-add buttons

description: Quick-add buttons on the app's Home, for something the person adds often ("Coffee $4", "Walked the dog"): each opens a track's form with answers filled in, or with instant adds its row in one tap, dated when tapped (then preset must fill every required column but the date). action list shows them all; add makes one for a track (label, preset, instant); remove takes one away by its quickAddId from list.

label.description: add: what the button says, under 60 characters.

preset.description: add: answers by column key, from list_tracks.

name: quick_adds
